heading: Daily. Two Formats.
body: Once-daily Dutasteride capsules, compounded with Biotin at 0.1mg or retail at 0.5mg. May block both types of 5-alpha reductase for comprehensive DHT reduction.
activeIngredientsLabel: Active Ingredients: Dutasteride, Biotin (0.1mg compounded capsule)

ingredients.name: Dutasteride
ingredients.body: Dual 5-alpha reductase inhibitor. Oral capsule for systemic DHT reduction.*

ingredients.name: Biotin
ingredients.body: A B vitamin that may support healthy hair growth. Included in the 0.1mg compounded capsule, not in the retail 0.5mg capsule.

safety.title: Common side effects
safety.body: Decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, decreased semen volume, breast tenderness or enlargement, and mood changes.

safety.title: Tell your healthcare provider
safety.body: Share any history of liver disease, prostate conditions, current prescriptions including alpha blockers, and any plans for blood donation while on dutasteride.

safety.title: Do not use if
safety.body: You are a woman or a child. Dutasteride is a medication for men only. Women who are or may become pregnant should never handle dutasteride-containing medications.

safety.title: Seek medical care
safety.body: Severe allergic reaction (rash, swelling, trouble breathing), persistent breast changes, severe mood changes, or signs of high-grade prostate disease.
